name: Never Overpay Again
tagline: Shop smart, pick the right card, claw back what you're owed.
rationale: Most overpaying is quiet: the wrong card, a missed refund, a warranty window that closed. This bundle decides whether to buy at all, compares the real landed cost, puts the spend on the card that pays you back, and then makes sure you claim every refund and never miss a return window. It never buys anything without you.

members.name: Deal Hunting
members.reason: Compares what you'll actually pay, shipping and tax in, across your preferred retailers rather than the sticker price.

members.name: Review This
members.reason: Name a product and get a straight buy, skip, or pick-this-instead verdict before you spend.

members.name: Credit Card Max
members.reason: Tells you which card to put a purchase on for the most points and perks, and flags benefits you pay for but never use.

members.name: Returns & Warranties
members.reason: Warns you before a return, refund or warranty window quietly closes.

members.name: Bounty Hunter
members.reason: Digs through your email and bills for refunds and credits that are already yours but never got chased.
